_meta.rationale: Quanta Magazine's display face Tiempos Headline resolves to Playfair Display as the free alternative. Disclosure renders 'Quanta uses Tiempos Headline.' Confirmed 2026-06-13 via prod DB probe. Reference captures from quantamagazine.org home page at both viewports; color overlap confirmed >= 3 at both viewports (buckets: white/4095, near-black/273, light-gray/3822). Alphabet display element is h1.a-display-1.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['quanta.com/logo', 'quanta-logo', 'quanta-wordmark', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
